*Chronic disease isn't managed in a clinic. It is managed at home, in relationships, in the everyday. What's on the dinner table, what gets said, and who notices when someone's struggling. For the 130 million Americans managing a chronic condition, the healthcare system has offered the same answer for decades: a 15-minute doctor's visit, a pamphlet, and a portal login they'll never use.*

*At Nuna, we are building an AI health coach that shows up like a person who actually has time: available at 3am, infinitely patient, and never behind a waiting room. We use motivational interviewing to help patients and their families see themselves clearly, design experiments that fit their real lives, and navigate a system that has not historically been on their side. We are building from the ground up around a simple belief: patients don't want to be healthy; they want their lives back.*

*We're not competing with other health apps. We're competing with the moment a person gives up on getting better. If that's a problem you want to work on, we'd like to talk.*

**Your team**

Our products are only as good as the care and science behind them. We are a small team of engineers, designers, product managers, and clinicians who work together to build for both patients and providers.

You will be expected to own real pieces of the product from day one and be responsible for building, shipping, and supporting them in production.

**The role**

As a software engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end to end: you design them, build them, ship them, and keep them running. You'll work in the systems at the heart of the coach — the AI and agent logic, the services behind it, the data it depends on — and you'll make the day-to-day architecture and trade-off calls within your domain. You'll do this with a high degree of autonomy, and you'll help raise the bar for the engineers around you. Comfort with ambiguity matters here: the work rarely arrives fully specified.

**What you’ll do**

* Own meaningful features and services end to end — design, build, ship, and operate them in production
* Contribute to architecture decisions in the systems you work in, including the AI/agent and product systems at the core of the coach

* Treat privacy, security, and the responsible handling of health data as part of doing the job well
* Break ambiguous product problems into shippable work, making pragmatic trade-offs to deliver
* Partner with product, design, and the Data org to turn requirements into working software

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar field
* Strong engineering skills with the ability to own a feature or system end to end — backend services, APIs, and the code that ties them together
* Experience operating what you build: testing, deployment, and observability
* Comfort with ambiguity within your domain — able to move from a rough problem to a shipped solution
* Clear communication and the ability to work well across product, design, and engineering
* A genuine interest in improving healthcare alongside an interdisciplinary team
* **Able to work from our San Francisco office a minimum of 2 days per week**

**Bonus points**

* Experience with Kotlin, TypeScript, React, and Flutter
* Experience with AI/LLM product systems or agents
* You've worked with healthcare data, or in another high-trust, regulated domain
* Mobile experience, or experience bridging mobile clients and backend systems
* Experience shipping in an early-stage or fast-moving consumer product

Astra is building mission-critical infrastructure for moving money at scale. Our platform processes billions in annual transaction volume with 99.9%+ uptime, powering real-time transfers, bank debits, card disbursements, and complex financial compliance systems. We provide APIs and automation tools that enable businesses to move money programmatically while maintaining strict regulatory requirements.




THE ROLE

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own features end to end: Design, build, test, and deploy backend features and services across payments, fraud, compliance, and user management, then run and monitor what you ship

 - Integrate with financial partners and APIs: Build and maintain integrations with banks, card networks, and other third-party services, handling the edge cases that money movement demands

 - Contribute to design: Write and review technical designs for your own work, participate in architecture discussions, and learn how our domain-driven, event-driven approach fits together

 - Improve performance and reliability: Find and fix bottlenecks and failure modes across our microservices, and help raise the quality of our tests and observability

 - Collaborate across teams: Work closely with product and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into working software




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required Experience

 - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building production backend systems

 - Track record of delivering features independently, from ambiguous requirements to production, with sound judgment on when to ask for help

 - Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and computer science fundamentals

 - Working experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or microservices

 - Ability and willingness to travel up to ~15% annually

Education

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. We care more about demonstrated ability than credentials.

Technical Skills

 - Backend development: Python 3 and web frameworks and APIs (we use Flask)

 - Databases: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases

 - Cloud infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, or similar cloud platforms

 - Architecture patterns: Familiarity with domain-driven design, clean architecture, and CQRS is a plus

Preferred Experience

 - Financial systems: Payment processing, fraud detection, or compliance systems

 - Financial regulations: Familiarity with AML, KYC, PCI DSS, or similar regulations

 - Banking integrations: Experience with financial APIs and money movement systems (ACH, card networks)

 - Third-party integrations: Experience building and maintaining integrations with external services

 - Scale and reliability: Experience with systems processing high transaction volumes




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

 - Direct impact: You'll be a big part of a small engineering team building systems that power a growing fintech platform

 - Complex problems: Work on sophisticated challenges that few engineers get to solve

 - Room to grow: A path to broader scope and, over time, technical leadership as the team scales

 - Financial innovation: Build systems that enable new financial products and services




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation with equity in a growing fintech company.

 - Remote-first culture with flexible working arrangements

 - Small team, big impact — your work directly supports Astra’s ability to scale responsibly

 - Mission-driven — build infrastructure that powers financial innovation while meeting the highest regulatory standards




REMOTE WORK AND CULTURE

Astra is a remote-first company hiring only within the U.S. We value thoughtful collaboration, clarity, and initiative. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.




HOW TO APPLY

 - We're looking for engineers who are excited by complex systems problems and have the educational background and experience to handle sophisticated challenges. 

 - If you're passionate about building mission-critical financial infrastructure and want to have a direct impact on our technical direction, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT US

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.



As an ML Research Engineer in the Visual Navigation team, you will join us at an early stage to heavily influence our technical direction. Operating out of Paris, Lausanne or Zurich, you will focus on developing Machine Learning models to enable our drones to navigate on the battlefield, with responsibilities ranging from data curation and model architecture definition to  onboard inference on our drones.

Responsibilities

 - DL Algorithm Development: Design deep learning models to analyze a drone's environment in multiple modalities and enable its localization through time and space.

 - Edge AI Optimization: Embed models on heterogeneous platforms with limited shared compute. Optimize trade-offs between model speed and accuracy to minimize pipeline latency.

 - Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with the VIO, Navigation, and Embedded Software teams to build a robust, real-time localization pipeline, communicating trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.

 - Research & Innovation: Stay at the absolute forefront of scientific trends in Deep Learning to introduce cutting-edge methodologies to the team.

 - Pipeline Management & MLOps: Build, heavily modify, and manage training, evaluation, and MLOps pipelines while ensuring reproducibility, robust logging, and version control.

 - Validation & Field Testing: Actively participate in real-world flight tests. Analyze in-field failures to continuously iterate and improve deployed models.
   
   

Candidate Requirements

 - Educational Background: Strong academic record with a STEM degree (e.g., Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, Mathematics).

 - Deep Learning & Computer Vision Expertise: Proven track record of researching and productizing Deep Learning models for Computer Vision in the industry (Drones, Robotics, Autonomous Vehicles, etc.) 

 - Technical Competence: Proficiency in Python and DL frameworks (PyTorch/Lightning). Experience with MLOps and edge deployment optimization.

Professional Attributes:

 - Highly structured, analytical, and research-oriented.

 - Excellent communicator able to translate complex algorithmic benchmarking to downstream users and stakeholders.

 - Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a hands-on, “no-task-is-too-small” mentality.
   

 - Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and growth plans, ready to go the extra mile for operational excellence.



We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
